decisions.reason: Reducing the initial package to one test video does not change the freelancer's full-service responsibility for footage, voiceover, and script.
The opening-hook standard remains applicable to the test video and is not changed by the reduction in video count.
The decision to begin with one video does not alter the required alignment with the winning reference creative.
The source changes the number of initial videos, not the conversion objective or target CPL.
The quicker-cut editing requirement remains valid for the single test video without modification.
The deferred landing-page and tracking audit is independent of the test-video package size.
